# polymarket-sports-mcp
> Tools and research for copying profitable Polymarket sports specialists onto Polymarket US, with every bet approved by a human. All data files below are generated by the copy pipeline (v4, 2026-11-08). No secrets are stored here.

- [docs/STRATEGY.md](docs/STRATEGY.md): the full method. Data endpoints, global→US slug mapping (aec/asc/tsc, UTC date fix, BUY_SHORT = 1 − price), selection tiers, credibility score, sizing rule, resting-order execution, fee formula, known pitfalls.
- [docs/BACKTEST.md](docs/BACKTEST.md): condensed walk-forward results. Post-mortem of the first picks, copy-rule table, ranking and sizing tests, stake rule vs. flat.
- [docs/TRADE_LOG.md](docs/TRADE_LOG.md): every real bet placed so far, with price, shares, fee, wallet copied, and result.
- [data/rankings.json](data/rankings.json): every wallet × league × bet-type segment with settled bets, own ROI, shrunk credibility score, sizing-skill stats, status (keep/watch/drop), and field definitions.
- [data/specialists.json](data/specialists.json): wallets currently copied (keep/watch tiers) and their allowed segments.
- [data/suppressed.json](data/suppressed.json): wallets profiled and not copied, with the reason. Rechecked after 30 days.
